title: TagDuel LP pipeline 4x4 physical-seat matrix

implementation.behavior: For each initial active seat and each physical drawing seat, the test resolves one Solemn Wishes copy controlled by team 0 and one Fire Princess owned by the other physical teammate. Team 0 draws gain 500 LP then plan one 500 LP burn; team 1 draws do not trigger team 0 copies. The source and burn preserve physical owner seats and the planners do not mutate the drawn game snapshot.

cardIdentities.name: Solemn Wishes
cardIdentities.role: 500 LP per eligible copy for one draw event

cardIdentities.name: Fire Princess
cardIdentities.role: 500 LP burn after positive LP gain

limitations: Solemn Wishes and Fire Princess remain unadmitted in the current resolver catalog; this matrix validates the independent TagDuel adapters/planners only.
No central resolver registration or live Discord interaction; M61 handoff remains pending.
